items.title: People need to start paying attention to the issue of derived data in AI training (2 minute read)
items.snippet: Derived data is creative content that is rewritten by AI before it is trained on.

items.title: Better GPT-6 Prompt Caching (4 minute read)
items.snippet: OpenAI improved prompt caching for GPT-6 with higher default cache hit rates, discounts for shared prefixes reused within 30 minutes, and new tools for monitoring and diagnosing cache performance.

items.title: Involution Without Export Is Wasted Effort (28 minute read)
items.snippet: If you don't go overseas, all that grinding was for nothing.
